name: Análisis de Cuadrícula de Artefactos de Bloqueo
description: Analiza JPEG block boundary artefactos para detectar inconsistent compression grids indicando alteración.
algorithm: Block Artifact Grid (BAG) Extraction and Consistency Analysis
mechanism: compresión JPEG creates an 8×8 block grid. When a region is spliced from a differently compressed source, the block grid alignment becomes inconsistent.
parameters: Tamaño de bloque: 8×8, Grid detección: cross-boundary gradiente, Alignment: phase análisis, Map: block visibility
source: Fan, Z. & de Queiroz, R. (2003) — Identification of Bitmap Compression History, IEEE TIP
useCase: Detecting spliced regions by finding compresión JPEG grid inconsistencias

references.title: Fan, Z. & de Queiroz, R. (2003) — Identification of Bitmap Compression History, IEEE TIP

strengths:
• Directly linked to compresión JPEG
• Can localize tampered regions
• Well-understood theoretical basis
• Effective on single-compressed images
limitations:
• Solo funciona con imágenes JPEG
• Double compression can mask artefactos
• Requires sufficient image quality
• May miss small tampered regions
